## Purpose and task IDs

Describe the problem and change. Link the milestone/task tickets and stable Mxx.yy IDs. For partial milestone work, use `Refs #N (Mxx.yy)`; reserve automatic closing keywords for a ticket whose full scope and exit gate are satisfied.

## Verification

List exact commands, results, and evidence paths. Identify mocks/emulators versus real-device results. State checks not run and why.

## Risks and compatibility

Describe state/schema migrations, privacy/security implications, dependency/license changes, and rollback.

## Tickets and documentation

- [ ] Relevant acceptance criteria are addressed, with limitations stated.
- [ ] Relevant tickets have a PR link, exact checks/results, limitations, and next task; unchecked work remains pending until owner acceptance/merge.
- [ ] Documentation and migration notes are updated where needed.
- [ ] No private stories, credentials, model weights, or unique device identifiers are included.
- [ ] Material AI assistance and third-party provenance are disclosed.

## Owner review

This PR does not authorize merging, releasing, changing access, or modifying governance. Final upstream acceptance belongs to @OptimumAF.
